purpose: Teach: 図る/プライバシー/改造/浸透/中野/対照/許諾/質的

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規市場への、本気で、絶対、進出を、絶対、図る、絶対、よう、絶対、戦略を、絶対、立てろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need to develop a serious strategy for entering new markets. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, commanding opening. Clipped consonants on key words. No wasted breath. The tone of someone used to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の、本気で、絶対、プライバシー、絶対、保護、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're maintaining strict customer privacy protections. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Slight formal bow in the voice. Each phrase lands with quiet completion. Professional reassurance without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 古い設備の、本気で、絶対、改造、絶対、計画、絶対、見直せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Review the equipment modernization plan. I want it reassessed.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. A slight pause before 'reassessed' — not a request. The expectation of immediate comprehension and action.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品、本気で、絶対、市場に、絶対、浸透、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're advancing new product penetration in the market. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact. Slight upward inflection on 'advancing' — reporting progress without overstating. Professional courtesy in the closing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 中野、本気で、絶対、支店、絶対、業績、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the Nakano branch's performance numbers. I need to see them.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. A brief pause for emphasis on 'performance.' The voice of someone who knows exactly what they're asking for and why.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前期と今期の、本気で、絶対、対照、絶対、表、絶対、作成しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'm preparing a comparative table of last quarter's and this quarter's numbers. Thank you.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Voice settles into each phrase. The tone of someone delivering what was asked for, on time, with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様の、本気で、絶対、許諾、絶対、取得、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure we have customer consent secured. It's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, no room for interpretation. Weight on 'consent' and 'secured.' The voice of someone stating a principle, not a preference.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社製品の、本気で、絶対、質的、絶対、向上、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're working on improving the quality of our products. Thank you.
lines.style: Even, professional. Slight warmth on 'improving' — small acknowledgment that this work matters. Closes with quiet completion.
